user.title: Yeelight Bluetooth
user.description: Control a Yeelight Bedside or Candela bluetooth lamp. Make sure the lamp is not connected to the Yeelight app or another device.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Yeelight Bluetooth
bluetooth_confirm.description: A Yeelight {model} was discovered ({address}). Home Assistant connects to the lamp when you submit. If the lamp pulses, push its small button within 30 seconds to finish pairing.

pick_device.title: Yeelight Bluetooth
pick_device.description: Lamps seen by the Home Assistant bluetooth adapters and proxies. Home Assistant connects to the lamp when you submit. If the lamp pulses, push its small button within 30 seconds to finish pairing.

manual.title: Yeelight Bluetooth
manual.description: Enter a name and the MAC address of the lamp. Home Assistant connects to the lamp when you submit. If the lamp pulses, push its small button within 30 seconds to finish pairing.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure {name}
reconfigure.description: Change the model of the lamp {address}. Select the model when it is not detected correctly.

error.invalid_mac: This is not a valid MAC address (format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).
error.not_found: Home Assistant does not see this lamp. Make sure it is powered and in range of a bluetooth adapter or proxy.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to or pair with the lamp. Make sure it is not connected to the Yeelight app; if it pulses, push its button. Resetting the lamp may help.

abort.already_in_progress: The configuration of this lamp is already in progress.
abort.not_supported: This device is not a supported Yeelight lamp.
abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured lamp found. Ensure the lamp is in range of a bluetooth adapter or proxy and not connected to another app. Resetting the lamp may help.

unknown_model.title: Model of {name} not detected
unknown_model.description: The lamp {address} does not advertise its model, so the Bedside protocol is used. If this is a Candela, open the integration, select **Reconfigure** on {name} and choose the model.

no_scanner.message: No bluetooth scanner detected. Enable the bluetooth integration or set up an ESPHome bluetooth proxy.

device_not_found.message: Could not find the Yeelight lamp with address {address}.

command_failed.message: Could not send the command to {name}.
